project_type: Monorepo: existing Expo/React Native app (APP) + NEW Vite + React 18 + Tailwind CSS web module (apps/macros-web). The web module is a real DOM React app where Tailwind CSS, <select>/<input>, backdrop-blur and Google Fonts render natively.
build_system: Root Expo app uses expo/metro + jest-expo. NEW web module uses Vite (build/dev), Vitest (unit/integration), Playwright (E2E). npm as package manager (package-lock.json present).
test_framework: Web module: Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom for unit/integration; Playwright for E2E. Root app: jest-expo (untouched).
verification_instructions: In apps/macros-web: `npm install`, then `npm run test -- --run` (unit+integration via Vitest), `npm run build` (tsc + vite build), `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`. E2E: `npm run build` then `npm run test:e2e` (Playwright serves the dist). Pure macro-math suite must pass with high coverage; wizard integration tests cover navigation + per-step validation gating.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Vite build output goes to apps/macros-web/dist (gitignored). Coverage reports gitignored.
setup_instructions: Node 20+ (v22 present). From repo root: `cd apps/macros-web && npm install`. Dev: `npm run dev` (Vite on http://localhost:5173). No env vars, no secrets, no backend.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET: npm installs, create-vite deps, and Google Fonts all reachable. Playwright chromium may need `npx playwright install chromium`. The root Expo app is React Native where Tailwind CSS does NOT apply, which is WHY a separate DOM web module is required.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits. ESLint no-console (error) => 'Guardar mis metas' must be a state-driven success UI, NOT console.log. Immutability, small files (<800 lines, functions <50 lines), zod validation of all input, no hardcoded secrets. Min 80% coverage with unit+integration+E2E.
key_patterns: Pure domain logic lives in src/features/energy/domain/{energyCalculator,energy.schema,activityLevels,harrisBenedict.constants,CalculationInputError}.ts and is plain TS (no RN imports) => portable. REUSE calculateTdee (revised Harris-Benedict 1984; multipliers 1.2/1.375/1.55/1.725/1.9) rather than reimplementing. Feature-based folders. Design tokens centralized (src/theme in RN app => tailwind.config theme.extend for web).
relevant_files: src/features/energy/__tests__/energyCalculator.test.ts (pattern to mirror for macro math tests)
directory_structure: APP/app (Expo routes), APP/src/features/{welcome,energy}, APP/src/theme, APP/.tasks (plan markdown). NEW: APP/apps/macros-web/ (Vite web module) with src/{domain,features/macros-wizard,theme}, config files, tests.
